integrity: Original proof and finite reproducibility program accompany the result; computational checks are not substitutes for an infinite argument; no external independent audit or certification is represented.
scientific_limitations: Alphabet fixed for asymptotics; no unequal-adjacency restrictions beyond one-symbol repeats; standard renewal limit theorem cited rather than reproved. Formal proof applies to every finite alphabet size. Machine checks cover finite lengths only. Global novelty remains subject to less-visible sources.
title: Subsequence universality in proper-coloring words: exact spectra and renewal laws
